name: ATLAS V.O Grid Benchmarking Suite
description: Grids include heterogeneous resources, which are based on different hardware and software architectures or components. In correspondence with this diversity of the infrastructure, the execution time of any single job, as well as the total grid performance can both be affected substantially, which can be demonstrated by measurements. Running a simple benchmarking suite can show this heterogeneity and give us results about the differences over the grid sites.
reputation: An early grid-computing benchmarking suite used to characterize heterogeneity across distributed grid sites, but not a modern mainstream ML benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM distributed-systems benchmark; results depend heavily on hardware, software stack, and site-specific conditions.
